title: Playwright regressions: F2 list selectors stability and OBS-04 outdated login selectors
root_cause: E2E tests relied on brittle assumptions: list assertions did not scope results to created fixtures, and OBS-04 still used deprecated email/password selectors after token-login migration.
resolution: Scoped F2 list assertions via deterministic name filtering and migrated OBS-04 to token-based login selectors with health readiness stub.
prevention: E2E tests that depend on fixture rows must pre-filter to unique fixture identifiers, and login selectors must be aligned with current auth UX contracts.
